script_text: Stop! Gemini, the stars are screaming right now — Mercury is about to flip your script. Mercury, your ruling air planet, sits in Virgo in your 4th House of Home and forms a tense square to Saturn in Sagittarius in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating friction between domestic duties and relationship demands. In love, Venus in Libra in your 5th House of Romance sextiles Mars in Leo in your 3rd House of Communication, so single Geminis should accept a spontaneous invite while attached Geminis plan a weekend getaway. For career and money, Jupiter in Cancer in your 2nd House of Money trines Mercury, signaling a modest but unexpected financial gain linked to a family property or home investment. Avoid signing a lease after dark—hidden clauses could cost you later. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week and weekend.
